bias.label: Leaning down below 3,500; broken support now resistance

event: Thu 26 Nov: Thanksgiving, US markets shut, thin trade. Fri 27 Nov: US stocks close early. Next big event: Fed decision Wed 9 Dec, 21:00 SAST.

bullets.title: Broke below 3,500
bullets.text: COMEX December gold was 3,477.20, down 2.38%, at 16:32 SAST, and one report put spot as low as 3,454 (spot time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Hot US data
bullets.text: October PCE was 3.8% y/y and core 3.3% (up from 3.1%), and Q3 GDP was revised up to 4.3%; the core forecast is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Hike still priced
bullets.text: After the data, CME FedWatch showed about 96% odds of a 25 bp Fed hike on 9 December.

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index was near 103.9 and the US 10-year yield about 4.9% this morning; levels after the data are UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Cash selling
bullets.text: Falling tech stocks are pushing traders to sell gold for cash, and gold ETFs are seeing outflows.

bullets.title: Oversold, still falling
bullets.text: RSI is near 25-28, so sharp bounces can happen, but COMEX gold is down about 13% this month.

bullets.title: Thin holiday trade
bullets.text: With US markets shut on Thursday, moves can be jumpy and spreads wide.

levels.note: Broken support: round 3,500 and last week's 3,502 low

buy.title: Buy plan: 3,440-3,460 holds (counter-trend)
look: This is against the main downtrend, so use half size or skip it.
A slow test of 3,440-3,460 with long lower wicks, not a fast flush through it.
A higher low on the 15M chart and a close back above 3,460.
Take some profit at 3,484 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying just because RSI is oversold. Wait for the level to hold.
A 1H close under 3,431 opens 3,380-3,400. Step aside.
Thin Thanksgiving trade can spike price through stops. Keep size small.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That turns a small loss into a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: retest of 3,500 fails (with the trend)
look: Price bounces back up into 3,500-3,506 and stalls there.
A clear 15M rejection wick or a bearish close back under 3,500.
Take some profit at 3,460 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling low at 3,450-3,477 into support with RSI oversold. Wait for the bounce.
A 1H close above 3,520 opens 3,546-3,552. Do not fight it.
Fed or trade headlines can reverse price fast in thin holiday trade.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
